reviewPolicy: Additive offline review of explicit provider extras. Complete timed, unique, version-safe mappings and defensible parent-album identity are required. A complete original album disc inside a named expanded repackage may use the core album as a metadata representative, but this does not identify the source pressing or authorize replacing expanded-package/disc identity. Isolated songs in another album or compilation remain unresolved. Existing comparison and duration rules are unchanged. No hard negative or verified abstention is inferred, and no acoustic or native quality is claimed. Independent source review is retained under .amp/in/artifacts/offline-eval-expansion-20261116/.

cases.reason: Only Time - The Collection CD2 is not A Box of Dreams or the Watermark & Shepherd Moons two-album package. Matching songs scattered over their media do not establish the local parent collection. Book of Days also has an explicit English/Gaelic recording annotation in the MusicBrainz alternatives; local title alone does not settle version.

Local Stan three-track single is not the 1999-2002 MP3 compilation titled Eminem (Discogs 5276460). Stan, Get You Mad and My Name Is occur at unrelated compilation positions. Preserve Dido and Sway & King Tech / DJ Revolution / Eminem credits; song overlap cannot replace parent identity.

Local COPYCAT (Sofi Tukker remix) standalone release is not dont smile at me (deluxe edition). The proposed parent is explicitly Bootleg; preserving the remix qualifier and close duration does not establish that parent.
Local On My Mind standalone release is not Delirium. All 19 candidates are Delirium editions; exact song timing, including explicit/clean edition alternatives, does not establish the local parent.

Local The Real Slim Shady three-track single is not the MP3 compilation Eminem (5276460). Compilation positions 31, 42 and 3 do not represent this single. Instrumental qualifier is retained but insufficient.

Local The Slim Shady LP special-edition Bonus CD is not the MP3 compilation Eminem (5276460). Three consecutive compilation entries 21-23 are song-level evidence, not evidence that this compilation is the local parent. Acapella labels must stay intact; Get You Mad credits are richer in the provider.

Only Time - The Collection CD1 is not A Box of Dreams. All four candidates scatter the twelve local tracks across three different media; complete song overlap cannot replace the four-CD parent identity.
Local Bitches Broken Hearts standalone release is not dont smile at me expanded/deluxe. Song 11 in that EP (including a bootleg alternative) cannot establish the single parent.
Local The Real Slim Shady two-track single is not compilation Eminem (25741690). Tracks 2 and 12 overlap, but the provider labels this a compilation/unofficial release rather than this single.

Local Survival explicit single is not E (5208521), an unofficial mixed compilation. Provider track 2 lacks an explicit-version assertion; compatible timing alone settles neither parent nor explicit version.
Local MOOO! single is not Amala deluxe. The 10 album candidates also include clean, explicit, 360 Reality Audio and bootleg variants; matching title/duration does not choose among those versions.

Local Tia Tamera single is not Amala deluxe. Rico Nasty credit is corroborated by MusicBrainz and Discogs Featuring credits, but clean/explicit/360 variants and the album parent cannot be inferred from timing.

cases.reviewNotes: Accept only as a Relapse core-album metadata representative for local Refill CD1, not as the source pressing or full Refill edition. All 20 local album tags say Relapse; all 20 titles map uniquely in original order to provider 1-20, with measured deltas at most 0.014 seconds. The provider is an Official 2009 Digital Media Relapse edition. Local filenames name Dr. Dre on 13 and Dr. Dre & 50 Cent on 18, agreeing with provider track credits. Provider extras 21-22 are explicitly single versions, so cannot be substituted for album tracks 9/18. The folder Refill suffix identifies a repackaged parent, but this complete first disc is the Relapse album, unlike isolated singles or a different compilation. Scope is core album fields and per-track mappings only; do not replace Refill packaging/disc identity or claim native matching success.

cases.reason: Local MyBoi (TroyBoi remix) standalone release is not dont smile at me (deluxe edition), explicitly Bootleg. Exact remix qualifier and close duration establish only song overlap.

Local Juicy single explicitly credits Doja Cat;Tyga. The proposed Amala track 14 credits only Doja Cat in MusicBrainz, and Discogs supplies no Tyga featured credit. Parent differs and the absent guest strongly warns of a different solo/remix version despite close duration. Do not erase Tyga.
Local Fingers Crossed standalone release is not eilish, explicitly Bootleg. The punctuation-normalized song at track 13 and compatible duration do not establish this collection as the parent.

Local 3AM promotional single (filename Album Version) is not a Relapse or Relapse: Refill album. All 43 alternatives only contain its song. Clean and explicit recordings can have nearly identical lengths. Discogs 10590303 additionally repeats position 2 across media; position-only mapping is ambiguous even though the unchanged reviewer passes.
Local Something In The Way You Move standalone release is not Delirium. All 19 candidates are album editions; the song at 3 or 1-3 and compatible timing cannot establish the standalone parent.

Local Lovely standalone release credits Billie Eilish & Khalid, corroborated on the proposed EP track 10. It is nevertheless not dont smile at me expanded/deluxe; guest-credit agreement cannot establish a different parent.

Local CMon Let Me Ride parent and album artist are Skylar Grey, featuring Eminem. Proposed E (5208521) is an unofficial mixed Eminem compilation and its track 5 lacks the local artist credit. Folder-level Eminem association is not a parent-artist match; the 6.04-second timing delta also cannot prove version identity.
